verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents server-side and client-side import of existing purchase data (receipts/purchase tokens) into RevenueCat, which supports migrating subscribers from another IAP setup without disrupting live subscriptions, and community threads confirm this is a common ops use case people want. However there is no evidence of spreadsheet-based import, nor of PCI-compliant card-data transfer (RevenueCat's IAP migration relies on Apple/Google receipts, not card data), and a community user explicitly asks whether cross-platform (IAP<->Stripe) migration is smooth without a confirmed answer. Missing for 10: spreadsheet import tooling, explicit PCI/card-data transfer mechanism, and confirmed hands-on success migrating from a competing platform without customer disruption.
